versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the DCF估值工具 skill.
- Supports two valuation methods: traditional DCF (Gordon model) and PE exit method.
- Provides a structured workflow: data collection, qualitative/quantitative analysis, scenario calculation, and report output.
- Includes sample parameter settings and clear comparison of both methods.
- Saves valuation reports to a local user-specified directory.
- Trigger words: 估算DCF, DCF估值, 内在价值, 十年估值, 自由现金流折现, PE退出, 段永平式估值.
